verdict.rationale: DBOS provides DBOS.send()/recv() with topic-based queuing to send messages/signals into a specific running workflow from outside, explicitly documented for human-in-the-loop scenarios (e.g., waiting hours/days for approval), plus DBOSClient for interacting with workflows from external code or another DBOS application, and workflow handles for retrieving results. This directly matches the story of signaling a running workflow via API/webhook/another workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration specifically of the send/recv mechanism (community evidence covers durability/performance but not this exact feature).
